title: Sweet as Honey
question: What was 'sweet as honey' and why?

meanings.usage: 指飞机、车辆等猛烈撞击或坠落
用于描述交通工具的事故
形容地理位置偏僻、人迹罕至的地方

meanings.meaning: 未受干扰的；原封不动的
meanings.usage: 指保持原样、没有被打扰的状态
指从飞机上进行的地形或区域勘察
指对某事物有强烈兴趣和热情的人
指将损坏的东西修复到原来的状态
指机器或车辆的动力装置
指保持某物的原有状态，防止损坏
指某人或某物的状态或情况
指将物品装箱或包裹以便运输
指再次发现之前被遗忘的东西
指蜜蜂酿造的甜物质，也比喻甜蜜美好
指蜜蜂分泌的黄色蜡状物质，用于建造蜂巢
指从危险或困境中救出

phrases.usage: 表示一群蜜蜂，用于描述蜂群

examples.en: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive.
examples.zh: 一群蜜蜂把这个发动机变成了蜂巢。

phrases.usage: 形容某物像蜂蜜一样甜，文中用于形容发动机保存完好

examples.en: The fourth engine was sweet as honey--still in perfect condition.
examples.zh: 第四台发动机甜如蜂蜜——状况仍然完美。

examples.en: A Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare.
examples.zh: 状况良好的兰开斯特轰炸机很罕见。

examples.en: They broke open the packing cases.
examples.zh: 他们撬开了包装箱。

examples.en: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France.
examples.zh: 法国当局把飞机包装好，拆成部件运回法国。

examples.en: The bees had turned the engine into a hive.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂把发动机变成了蜂巢。

phrases.usage: 表示这些年来的时间流逝

examples.en: But over the years the crash was forgotten.
examples.zh: 但这些年来，坠机事故被遗忘了。

examples.en: It was rare and worth rescuing.
examples.zh: 它很罕见，值得拯救。

phrases.usage: 表示到那时、到这个时候

examples.en: By this time, a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare.
examples.zh: 到这时，状况良好的兰开斯特轰炸机已经很少见了。

examples.en: The plane was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey.
examples.zh: 这架飞机在一次航空测量中被意外重新发现。

sentences.en: In 1963 a Lancaster bomber crashed on Wallis Island,
sentences.zh: 1963年，一架兰开斯特轰炸机坠毁在沃利斯岛，

sentences.en: a remote place in the South Pacific, a long way west of Samoa.
sentences.zh: 一个位于南太平洋的偏远地方，在萨摩亚以西很远。

sentences.en: The plane wasn't too badly damaged,
sentences.zh: 飞机没有损坏得太严重，

sentences.en: but over the years the crash was forgotten and the wreck remained undisturbed.
sentences.zh: 但多年来，这次坠机事件被遗忘，残骸也一直未被触动。

sentences.en: Then in 1989, twenty-six years after the crash, the plane was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey of the island.
sentences.zh: 1989年，坠机26年后，在一项对该岛的空中勘测中，这架飞机被意外重新发现。

sentences.en: By this time, a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare and worth rescuing.
sentences.zh: 此时，一架状况尚可的兰开斯特轰炸机已属罕见，值得营救。

sentences.en: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France.
sentences.zh: 法国当局将飞机打包，并分批运回法国。

sentences.en: Now a group of enthusiasts are going to have the plane restored.
sentences.zh: 现在，一群爱好者正准备修复这架飞机。

sentences.en: It has four Rolls-Royce Merlin engines but the group will need to have only three of them rebuilt.
sentences.zh: 它有四台劳斯莱斯梅林发动机，但该团队只需要重建其中三台。

sentences.en: Imagine their surprise and delight when they broke open the packing cases
sentences.zh: 想象一下，当他们打开包装箱时，是多么惊喜和高兴，

sentences.en: and found that the fourth engine was sweet as honey--still in perfect condition.
sentences.zh: 发现第四台发动机“甜如蜂蜜”——仍然处于完美状态。

sentences.en: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive and it was totally preserved in beeswax!
sentences.zh: 一群蜜蜂把发动机变成了一个蜂巢，它完全被蜂蜡保存了下来！

exercises.prompt: “坠毁；撞毁” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: crash · /kræʃ/ · verb · 坠毁；撞毁。指飞机、车辆等猛烈撞击或坠落

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：修复；恢复
exercises.explain: restore · /rɪˈstɔː/ · verb · 修复；恢复。指将损坏的东西修复到原来的状态

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved _____ back to France.
exercises.hint: 法国当局把飞机包装好，拆成部件运回法国。
exercises.explain: in parts：表示拆分成零件/部件（法国当局把飞机包装好，拆成部件运回法国。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：The plane wasn't too _____ damaged,
exercises.hint: 飞机没有损坏得太严重，
exercises.explain: The plane wasn't too badly damaged, — 飞机没有损坏得太严重，

source.en: The plane wasn't too badly damaged,

exercises.prompt: “表示在过去某个时间点之前已经完成的动作，或用于描述过去的过去” 描述的是哪个语法点？
options: 现在完成时与否定式 (has/have never + 过去分词)
一般过去时 vs 过去进行时
exercises.explain: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)：had + 过去分词：在叙述过去事件时，用于描述在叙述时间点之前已经发生的动作，常与一般过去时连用

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive and it was totally preserved in beeswax!
options: 当他问莱恩先生是否住在那儿时，值班警察告诉他，自从失利后，这位前首相就出国了。
他发现了一条缠绕在16000伏高压电线上的蛇的残骸。
一群蜜蜂把发动机变成了一个蜂巢，它完全被蜂蜡保存了下来！
exercises.explain: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive and it was totally preserved in beeswax! — 一群蜜蜂把发动机变成了一个蜂巢，它完全被蜂蜡保存了下来！

source.en: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive and it was totally preserved in beeswax!

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某个时间点之前已经完成的动作，或用于描述过去的过去
grammar.usage: 在叙述过去事件时，用于描述在叙述时间点之前已经发生的动作，常与一般过去时连用

examples.en: The crash was forgotten and the wreck remained undisturbed. (crash是26年前的事)
examples.zh: 坠机事故被遗忘了，残骸未被扰动。

examples.en: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive.
examples.zh: 一群蜜蜂把发动机变成了蜂巢。

grammar.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
grammar.definition: 当主语是动作的承受者时，使用被动语态
grammar.usage: 强调动作的承受者，或不知道动作的执行者时使用

examples.en: The plane was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey.
examples.zh: 这架飞机在一次航空测量中被意外重新发现。

examples.en: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France.
examples.zh: 法国当局把飞机包装好，拆成部件运回法国。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某个时刻正在进行的动作
grammar.usage: 用于描述过去正在发生的事情，或与一般过去时连用表示背景

examples.en: The plane wasn't too badly damaged.
examples.zh: 飞机损坏得不太严重。

original.en: In 1963 a Lancaster bomber crashed on Wallis Island.
original.zh: 1963年，一架兰开斯特轰炸机坠毁在瓦利斯岛上。

examples.en: In 2008 she graduated from university.
examples.zh: 2008年她从大学毕业了。

examples.en: In 1995 this building was constructed.
examples.zh: 1995年这栋建筑被建造。

original.en: The plane wasn't too badly damaged, but over the years the crash was forgotten.
original.zh: 飞机损坏得不太严重，但这些年来坠机事故被遗忘了。

examples.en: The book was very interesting and I read it in one day.
examples.zh: 这本书很有趣，我一天就读完了。

examples.en: The problem was quite serious and needed immediate action.
examples.zh: 这个问题相当严重，需要立即处理。

patterns.pattern: It has/had + 数量词 + 名词

original.en: It has four Rolls-Royce Merlin engines.
original.zh: 它有四台劳斯莱斯 Merlin 引擎。

examples.en: The house has three bedrooms and a garden.
examples.zh: 这栋房子有三间卧室和一个花园。

examples.en: The team has five members from different countries.
examples.zh: 这个团队有来自不同国家的五名成员。

original.en: Imagine their surprise and delight when they broke open the packing cases.
original.zh: 想象一下当他们撬开包装箱时的惊讶和喜悦。

examples.en: Imagine his disappointment when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 想象一下当他听到这个消息时的失望。

examples.en: Imagine our excitement when we won the lottery.
examples.zh: 想象一下当我们中彩票时的兴奋。
